setup: Two existing frequent pins; initial screen is Desk. Pin setup costs two pointer clicks on a new browser and is excluded consistently with prior trace.
keyboardCounting: Each shortcut, whole query entry, or Enter counts once; individual characters are not counted.

steps.action: Reference Desk is the initial screen
Cmd K + query + Enter generates regional monster
Search Stock Room, keep Common/Sarkash, ROLL
Broken quick rule OPEN, no dice
Stock Room pin and Broken/Corpse recents persist

classification.essentialChoice: Selecting a requested table/region, executing its roll, entering a query, copying and pinning. Stock retains source-defined parameter choice.
classification.informationReveal: Opening the monster source chain and reading Broken; retained.
classification.navigationOverhead: Opening search, opening Recent and Back; Cmd+K combines closing the current view and opening search.
classification.implementationOverhead: No save dialog, Campaign selection or Session creation. Reload is an explicit persistence test, counted separately.
